requirements.rule: Without an explicit page or limit, the exam command exhausts all server pages and preserves the total.

acceptance.given: A signed-in user has 104 exams across two REST pages.
acceptance.when: The real exam command prints JSON without pagination flags.
then: All 104 exams, including the last page, are printed once.
The combined total and page size are 104.

requirements.rule: Explicit page or limit flags select one REST page without auto-fetching further pages.

acceptance.given: An exam command includes page and/or limit plus date and semester filters.
acceptance.when: The real command requests its list and prints a table.
then: Exactly one request uses the selected page and pageSize.

requirements.rule: A failed later exam page fails the command without printing partial results.

acceptance.given: The first exam page succeeds and the second returns forbidden.
acceptance.when: The command tries to read the complete exam list.

requirements.rule: Explicit page, limit and semester identifiers must be positive; limit is at most 100.

acceptance.given: Exam flags contain zero, negative values or limit 101.
then: Invalid input fails before reading exams.

requirements.rule: Room-map lookup uses the catalog room code route and preserves the returned room code.

acceptance.given: The server provides a highlighted map for B001.
acceptance.when: The production CLI room-map client requests B001.

requirements.rule: Room codes are trimmed and empty codes are rejected.

acceptance.given: Room input has surrounding whitespace or only whitespace.
then: Nonempty codes preserve their content after trimming.

requirements.rule: Each exam row in the table identifies its semester.

acceptance.given: A returned exam belongs to 2026 Fall.
acceptance.when: The actual exam command prints its table.
then: The table includes the exam semester.
